messages:
Keisha: Hey folks, opening my first PR to change the default batch_size for the inference runtime. Quick Qs: preferred branch name pattern, who reviews perf-sensitive changes, and any minimal local smoke checks I should run?

Tom: Welcome! Branch off `main`. We like `team/short-desc` for tiny fixes (e.g. `infra/add-default-batchsize`) or `feature/ENG-####-short` if tracked.

Mira: For reviewers: runtime changes -> ping @Mira, infra/platform -> @Tom, and always check CODEOWNERS. For perf-sensitive edits add the `runtime-impact` label.

Keisha: Thanks. Do I need to run GPU benchmarks locally?

Mira: Not usually. For small config tweaks run the quick local bench: `./bench/local_infer_bench.sh --model rwt-small --tokens 256 --iters 10` and paste the median latency. CI runs full GPU suites.

DocsBot: If this config is surfaced to users or in docs/, please open a small docs PR or add a note under the "Runtime config" doc.

Tom: Also run `make lint && pytest tests/ -k fast` to catch flake/lint before pushing. CI will fail on lint errors.

Keisha: What do reviewers expect in the PR body for perf changes?

Mira: Short checklist in the PR body: 1) What changed (one-liner), 2) Quick bench results (command + median), 3) Expected impact (tokens/sec or p95), 4) Rollout plan (canary, monitor metrics). Example: `Bench command: ./bench/local_infer_bench.sh ...; median latency: 24ms -> 22ms`.

ci-bot: Tip: to retry a failing unit job locally use `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh <job>` or click "Re-run jobs" in GH Actions and tag me in the PR.

Keisha: Great — I'll branch as `infra/add-default-batchsize`, include the bench snippet and checklist, run lint+fast tests, and ping @Mira. Thanks! :tada:
